item.title: Lancashire Holdings Ltd — Lancashire posted H1 2026 profit of $141.7m and 19.6% annualised RoE, declaring a 7.5c interim dividend and reaffirming high-teens full-year RoE guidance.
item.description: [HIGH] Lancashire Holdings reported an H1 2026 profit of $141.7 million , giving an annualised RoE of 19.6% . Gross premiums written $1,315.0 million (down 1% underlying year-on-year); insurance revenue $930.0 million , broadly flat; Group RPI of 92% reflects softening but not soft conditions. item.title: St. James's Place plc — St. James's Place posts H1 2026 record FUM of £240.8bn and net inflows of £2.7bn, though adjusted IFRS pre-tax profit fell to £278.4m.
item.description: [HIGH] St. James's Place plc reported H1 2026 results with record funds under management of £240.8 billion (31 December 2025: £220.0 billion ), aided by investment returns of 16.4% of opening FUM annualised. Net inflows of £2.7 billion (2025: £3.8 billion ) on gross inflows of £10.5 billion (flat), with FUM retention improving to 95.4% (2025: 95.3%).
